remaining.problem: Critical no-key outline warnings, compilation disclaimer, main controls and processing disclosure remain English even when Russian document language is selected. Hypothesis: Mira may miss the distinction between a compiled outline and coursework ready for submission.
remaining.heuristic: Match between system and user language; error prevention
remaining.suggestion: Provide Russian equivalents for the outline warning, review action and server-processing disclosure, preserving the distinction between document language and interface language.

remaining.problem: PDF rejection tells the user to choose .txt or .md but gives no concrete route for an existing PDF requirement sheet. Hypothesis: the deadline-driven beginner may not know how to proceed.
remaining.heuristic: Help users recognize, diagnose and recover from errors
remaining.suggestion: Add concise guidance to copy requirement text from the PDF into the specification text field or save it as UTF-8 .txt.
